messages.subject: Changing methylRaw to methylBase
messages.body_plain:
So I have a couple of BAM files that I am trying to do differential methylation analysis on. I used processBismarkAln and then added them to the methylRawList.

calculateDiffMeth only takes methylBase or methylBaseDB object however. Is there a way to convert methylRawList to methylBase?

files <- list.files(path = WD1,
                    pattern = ".bam.sorted.bam$",
                    full.names = T, recursive = T)

library("methylKit")
obj1=processBismarkAln(files[1],"sham1",assembly="HKA",save.folder=WD2, save.context="CpG",read.context="CpG")
obj2=processBismarkAln(files[2],"sham2",assembly="HKA",save.folder=WD2, save.context="CpG",read.context="CpG")
obj3=processBismarkAln(files[3],"sham3",assembly="HKA",save.folder=WD2, save.context="CpG",read.context="CpG")
obj4=processBismarkAln(files[4],"low1",assembly="HKA",save.folder=WD2, save.context="CpG",read.context="CpG")
obj5=processBismarkAln(files[5],"low2",assembly="HKA",save.folder=WD2, save.context="CpG",read.context="CpG")
obj6=processBismarkAln(files[6],"low3",assembly="HKA",save.folder=WD2, save.context="CpG",read.context="CpG")
obj7=processBismarkAln(files[7],"high1",assembly="HKA",save.folder=WD2, save.context="CpG",read.context="CpG")
obj8=processBismarkAln(files[8],"high2",assembly="HKA",save.folder=WD2, save.context="CpG",read.context="CpG")
obj9=processBismarkAln(files[9],"high3",assembly="HKA",save.folder=WD2, save.context="CpG",read.context="CpG")
obj=methylRawList(obj1,obj2,obj3,obj4,obj5,obj6,obj7,obj8,obj9)

data(methylKit)
obj=methylRawList.obj[[1]]
methylRawList.obj[[length(methylRawList.obj)+1]]=obj1
methylRawList.obj@treatment=c(methylRawList.obj@treatment,0)
methylRawList.obj[[length(methylRawList.obj)+1]]=obj2
methylRawList.obj@treatment=c(methylRawList.obj@treatment,0)
methylRawList.obj[[length(methylRawList.obj)+1]]=obj3
methylRawList.obj@treatment=c(methylRawList.obj@treatment,0)
methylRawList.obj[[length(methylRawList.obj)+1]]=obj4
methylRawList.obj@treatment=c(methylRawList.obj@treatment,1)
methylRawList.obj[[length(methylRawList.obj)+1]]=obj5
methylRawList.obj@treatment=c(methylRawList.obj@treatment,1)
methylRawList.obj[[length(methylRawList.obj)+1]]=obj6
methylRawList.obj@treatment=c(methylRawList.obj@treatment,1)
methylRawList.obj[[length(methylRawList.obj)+1]]=obj7
methylRawList.obj@treatment=c(methylRawList.obj@treatment,2)
methylRawList.obj[[length(methylRawList.obj)+1]]=obj8
methylRawList.obj@treatment=c(methylRawList.obj@treatment,2)
methylRawList.obj[[length(methylRawList.obj)+1]]=obj9
methylRawList.obj@treatment=c(methylRawList.obj@treatment,2)

setwd(WD3)
objDB=makeMethylDB(obj)

calculateDiffMeth(objDB)

Did I choose right?

I did a regional DMR analysis of the promoter.
I would like to find and match the transcription ID or gene name for this promoter.
Is there an function in methylKit?
